cues.title: 先排除金属丝的干扰
cues.caption: 洁净金属丝不应引入明显焰色；钠盐使火焰显黄色。
cues.captionEn: A clean wire should add no conspicuous colour; sodium salt produces yellow.
cues.zh: 先看未带样品的洁净金属丝。教材要求排除金属丝本身和残留物的颜色，再观察钠盐引起的黄色。眼睛把许多光混合成一种焰色，光谱仪则能把波长分开。下面选取的钠谱线接近五百八十九纳米；它们的位置来自参考数据，画面的宽度和亮度只是为了看清。
cues.en: Begin with the clean wire so that residue does not masquerade as the sample’s colour. Sodium salt then produces yellow. The eye combines light into a flame colour, whereas a spectrometer separates wavelengths. The selected sodium lines lie near 589 nanometres. Their positions come from reference data; displayed width and brightness are enlarged for visibility.

cues.title: 钾的颜色可能被掩盖
cues.caption: 钾的紫色可被微量钠产生的强黄光干扰。
cues.captionEn: Potassium’s lilac appearance can be obscured by sodium’s strong yellow light.
cues.zh: 换成钾盐，观察原有的紫色与逐渐加入的黄光干扰。教材指出，微量钠盐也可能影响钾的焰色判断。图谱里钾的选取谱线没有因为混入钠而搬家，增加的是另一组波长的光。所以直接看混合颜色，与分开观察每组谱线，会得到不同清晰程度的证据。
cues.en: Switch to potassium and watch the growing yellow-light interference. As the textbook notes, even trace sodium can disturb a potassium flame test. The selected potassium lines do not move when sodium is added; light at another set of wavelengths is added. Looking at the combined colour and resolving the component lines therefore provide different levels of evidence.

cues.title: 钴玻璃选择透过的波长
cues.caption: 滤去大部分钠黄光后，更容易辨认钾的焰色。
cues.captionEn: Suppressing much of the sodium yellow makes potassium easier to distinguish.
cues.zh: 把蓝色钴玻璃放进观察光路。它改变的是透过光的组成，并没有改变样品中的元素，也没有把钠变成钾。注意黄色谱线变弱，而部分紫色和红端的光仍可透过。这里的透射曲线只是教学近似，真实玻璃的成分和厚度会影响结果。控制黄光干扰时，看到的变化来自同一个滤光模型。
cues.en: Insert cobalt-blue glass in the viewing path. It changes the transmitted light, not the elements in the sample. The yellow lines weaken while some violet and red-end light passes. This is an illustrative transmission curve, not a calibrated glass specification. Composition and thickness matter in real filters. The visible comparison and line attenuation follow the same model.

cues.title: 更大的能隙，会发出怎样的光？
cues.titleEn: What light comes from a larger gap?
cues.caption: 先预测波长，再比较两条允许跃迁。
cues.captionEn: Predict the wavelength, then compare two allowed transitions.
cues.zh: 把钠的一条黄光谱线接到两个能态。原子降到低能态，光子带走相同的能量。这两条线表示能量，不是绕核轨道。保持低能态不变，换一个更高的允许能态。先预测：能隙更大，波长更长还是更短？能量账本给出更短的波长。这条钠跃迁落在紫外区，眼睛看不见；灰色标记表示不可见光，不是更亮的黄光。
cues.en: Connect one sodium line to two energy states. A photon carries away the energy the atom loses. These lines show energies, not orbits. Keep the lower state and choose a higher allowed state. Predict first: does a larger gap mean a longer or shorter wavelength? Energy accounting gives a shorter wavelength. This sodium transition is ultraviolet, outside human vision. The neutral marker represents invisible light, not a brighter yellow flame.

cues.title: 有能量，还必须匹配
cues.titleEn: Energy must match an allowed gap
cues.caption: 匹配的光子可以改变原子能态。
cues.captionEn: A matching photon can change the atomic state.
cues.zh: 让光经过处在低能态的原子。先跟住不匹配的光子：在这个只选定一对能态的比较中，它通过，原子状态不变。再跟住匹配的一颗：光子被吸收，原子增加相同的能量。总能量没有消失，而是换了归属。能量更大的光子，也未必匹配这一次跃迁。真实吸收还取决于初态、跃迁规则和实验条件。
cues.en: Send light past an atom in the lower state. Follow an unmatched photon: in this selected-pair comparison, it passes and the state stays unchanged. Now follow a matching photon. It is absorbed, and the atom gains the same energy. The energy changes owner; it does not disappear. A higher-energy photon need not match this transition. Real absorption also depends on the initial state, transition rules and experimental conditions.

cues.title: 用多条固定谱线检验身份
cues.titleEn: Test identity with several fixed lines
cues.caption: 候选改变，未知样的谱线保持不动。
cues.captionEn: Changing the candidate does not move the unknown lines.
cues.zh: 保留这份固定的教学未知样。先只看黄光附近，几个候选可能难以分开。展开完整观察范围，再与教材中的锂、氦、汞参考图样比较。候选换了，未知样的谱线不动。多条位置一起吻合，才支持汞这个候选。每条线联系一种允许能量差，同一种元素可以有多条线。再加入钠的谱线：现在没有一个显示的纯元素能解释全部记录，需要考虑混合成分或更多参考数据。
cues.en: Keep this teaching unknown fixed. First look only near yellow, where candidates may be hard to separate. Reveal the full observed range and compare the textbook lithium, helium and mercury references. Changing candidates leaves the unknown unchanged. Several matching positions support mercury. Each line reflects an allowed energy difference; one element can have many lines. Add sodium lines: no displayed pure element now explains every record. Consider a mixture or more reference data.

cues.title: 暗线为什么只在特定位置出现？
cues.titleEn: Why do dark lines occur at particular positions?
cues.caption: 匹配的能隙与低能态占据，共同决定吸收。
cues.captionEn: Absorption needs both a matching gap and an occupied lower state.
cues.zh: 让连续光经过锂原子。跟住一颗匹配的光子：它被吸收，原子升到上能态，探测器方向就少了一颗。能量稍后还可以随光向其他方向释放，暗线不是能量消失。再看另一条锂跃迁，它从激发态出发。在刚准备好的基态样品中，这个起点空着，这条吸收就不出现。另做一次弱光探测，先准备一些原子在这个起点，暗线便能出现。能隙决定位置，起始状态也决定能否吸收。
cues.en: Pass continuous light through lithium atoms. Follow a matching photon: absorption raises the atom and removes a photon from the detector direction. Energy can later leave as light in another direction; a dark line does not destroy it. Another lithium transition starts from an excited state. In a freshly prepared ground-state sample, that starting state is empty, so this absorption is absent. In a separate weak-probe trial, populate that starting state first. The line can now appear. The gap sets its position; the initial state also controls absorption.

question.zh: 钴玻璃改变了火焰，还是到眼睛的光？
question.en: Does cobalt glass change the flame or the light reaching your eye?

lead.zh: 把教材中的钾盐、钠干扰和钴玻璃连成同一条光路，比较滤镜前后的光。
lead.en: Follow the textbook potassium flame, sodium interference and cobalt glass along one light path.

principle.zh: 发光源不变，滤光按波长改变透射强度；混合成分增加谱线而不搬动原来的线。
principle.en: An unchanged source is attenuated by wavelength; mixing adds lines without moving existing ones.

question.zh: 只有钠时，放入钴玻璃会得到钾的谱线吗？
question.en: Can cobalt glass create potassium lines from sodium alone?

explanation.zh: 不会。钠谱线只能被减弱，不能被滤镜移动或生成钾的谱线。
explanation.en: No. It attenuates sodium light without shifting its wavelengths or creating potassium lines.

question.zh: 能隙变大，发出的光怎样变？
question.en: What changes when an allowed energy gap grows?

lead.zh: 把一条真实钠谱线接到两个能态，跟住光子，并在另一条允许跃迁揭晓前预测波长。
lead.en: Connect a sodium line to its energy states, track a photon and predict a second allowed transition.

principle.zh: 原子能量减少等于光子能量；允许能隙越大，对应波长越短。吸收还要求初态与允许跃迁匹配。
principle.en: The photon carries the lost atomic energy: a larger allowed gap means a shorter wavelength. Absorption also requires a matching initial state and transition.

question.zh: 更高能量的光子一定更容易被这对能态吸收吗？
question.en: Is a higher-energy photon necessarily absorbed by this state pair?

explanation.zh: 不一定。它必须匹配允许能隙，而且原子要处在适当下能态。
explanation.en: No. It must match an allowed gap from a populated lower state.

question.zh: 几条亮线或暗线怎样检验元素身份？
question.en: How can bright or dark lines test an element’s identity?

lead.zh: 先检验固定未知样的谱线，再用锂原子的起始状态检验一条暗线能否出现。
lead.en: Test a fixed unknown spectrum, then change lithium’s initial state to test whether an absorption line appears.

principle.zh: 固定谱线与参考图样比较；同一允许能隙联系亮线与吸收位置，但吸收还受低能态占据控制。
principle.en: Compare fixed observed positions with reference patterns. Allowed gaps connect emission and absorption positions, but absorption also depends on lower-state population.

question.zh: 某条亮线能否在任何状态的样品中变成暗线？
question.en: Does every emission line become an absorption line in any sample state?

explanation.zh: 不能。该跃迁的下能态若没有原子占据，对应吸收不会按同样方式出现；还需相应光源与观察条件。
explanation.en: No. Its lower state must be populated, with suitable illumination and observing conditions.

title.zh: 光谱为什么能辨认元素？

description.zh: 从焰色和钴玻璃出发，追踪能态与光子的能量，检验固定谱线，并预测暗线何时出现。
description.en: Follow flame light through a filter, connect photons to atomic energies, and test fixed spectra and absorption predictions.

voiceRetention.physicalModelRetention: Keep ATOMIC_LINES Na/K and cobaltTransmission curve. Any edit affecting the first window must address a demonstrated bug, such as nonfinite inputs or displayed brightness disagreeing with the existing transmission model; no recalibration.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: An animated atom token between levels may imply forbidden stationary energies.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Only two discrete state occupancies and ledger values are physical states. A moving arrow is a visual annotation, not an intermediate atom state. Transfer energy at the event boundary; photon flight and off-axis re-emission retain explicit energy ownership.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: A full Hg spectrum should not be painted as one yellow unknown merely to create ambiguity.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Start with an explicitly restricted yellow observation window or coarse bin, then reveal the fixed full observed range. Do not recolour the entire Hg spectrum yellow. Candidate matching never regenerates the record.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: One selected-state off-resonant trial may otherwise imply no interaction with the entire real atom.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Show selected-pair/weak-probe limit beside the apparatus; no universal transparency claim. Photon energies remain below ionization in the planned presets.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: Li 610.3654 nm absorption starts at excited 2p; continuous pumping would invalidate a frozen population.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Compare separately prepared initial ensembles using a weak probe. No continuous pumping while holding occupancy fixed; no false thermal-population calculator. Only 2s and the selected 2p sublevel population are inputs.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: Line extinction must not destroy energy or imply every real photon radiates into the same new direction.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Trace one ideal radiative return as an example; ensemble attenuation is separate. Narrow detector geometry explains why an off-axis photon is not collected. Other decay routes are outside the model.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: NIST quoted air wavelengths differ from the vacuum relation E=hc/lambda.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Reference strips use air values; exact energy ledger uses the independently sourced level difference and derived vacuum wavelength. Rounded school readouts do not assert equality of air and vacuum data.

scientificBoundaryDecisions.issue: A populated Li 2p level is the lower level of 610.3654 nm but also the upper level of 670.7775 nm. A weak probe alone does not remove stimulated emission in a shared two-line net spectrum.
scientificBoundaryDecisions.decision: Keep 670.8 nm in a separately identified ground-state reference trial. Compare 610.4 nm in two separately prepared selected-pair weak-probe trials. Do not make the population control drive a claimed complete net two-line transmission spectrum of one common sample. Each trial visibly resets sample identity/initial state. No claim that weak light suppresses the relative stimulated-emission contribution.
